worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.summary: Lay a forest curse on the target: roots burst from the ground and bind it, adding the Grass type, and a patch of moss is left underfoot; only a non-Grass Pokemon with room for a third type can be cursed.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.use.0: add Grass and open Fire, Ice, Bug and Flying weaknesses
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.use.1: force a four-times Grass weakness on Water and Ground foes
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.use.2: with deep roots, hold both the curse and the moss longer
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.descripti: Add the Grass type to the target for %1$s; about %2$s roots break out where it lands (more with Special Attack).
Curse range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, following speed and size.
Moss ring about %1$s blocks, about %2$s falling leaves, moss lingers %3$s; larger and heavier bodies show more.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.rooted.on: Deep roots: curse lasts %1$s at %2$s cooldown, with deeper roots and a larger, longer moss ring.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.rooted.of: Shallow curse: faster wind-up, shorter cooldown, only a small patch of moss lingering %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.forestscurse.preferenc: On = Deep roots: curse x1.7, moss ring x1.35, moss linger x1.8, but +3 wind-up and +20 cooldown; off = Shallow curse: faster wind-up, -10 cooldown, only a small short-lived moss patch. Duration trades against cast frequency.
The companion only considers cursing a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to lay the curse.
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.curs: Cursed by the forest, Grass type added
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.lift: The forest curse lifts; the Grass type fades
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.noro: Already Grass or type layer full, no room for the curse
world_combat.move.forestscurse.text.fizz: No type to add to, the curse falls flat
